core.subject: Action Plan Timeline -- Gantt-style next steps with owners, priorities, and review triggers
objects: {{ACTION_ITEMS}} -- specific actions from the Decision Record Next Steps section, each with owner, timeline, and priority
{{REVIEW_TRIGGERS}} -- conditions or dates that trigger decision review
{{GUARDRAIL_ACTIONS}} -- actions tied to conditions and guardrails from the CEO decision
notes: {{TIMELINE_HORIZON}} -- total timeline span covered by the action plan
{{PRIORITY_DISTRIBUTION}} -- count of high / medium / low priority items
constraints: All text must be legible at 6.5 inch print width
No decorative elements -- every visual element conveys data
